content.text: where does the slot header live

The header is fixed-width and the slot table starts at 0x40. The DLL reads it through `FUN_1402e67f0`, so an MSVC CRT build and a DS2 SOTFS save agree on the RVA. Checked against the PE headers, the BND4 container and the MD5 in DS2SOFS0000.sl2; UTF-8 names decode, and CI is OK on this PR.
